Impacted Systems: Online stores supporting gift card purchase and balance check endpoints
Method of Attack: Brute-force attacks against gift card balance check endpoints by querying random gift card numbers to identify valid cards and their balances
Using the information to purchase goods or sell card details on the dark web
Attack Vector: Automated botnet querying gift card balance endpoints
Indicators of Compromise: Up to 1.7 million requests per hour on average, with peaks up to 4 million requests per hour
Use of over 6,400 unique device fingerprints per hour
Unusual traffic spikes on gift card balance check endpoints
